title: PHANTOM GRID Automotive Hardware Overcurrent & E-Fuse Isolation
full_script: PHANTOM GRID demonstrates hardware-level cyber defense against rogue automotive nodes. When unauthorized CAN ID 0x666 or firmware tampering is detected, an E-Fuse trip is triggered. In 1.8 microseconds, 100A peak cutoff current blows the circuit, permanently isolating transceiver pins. The node signature is computed and indelibly stamped into an immutable SHA-256 blacklist audit log. Exposed via vehicle MCP tools for autonomous AI Agent monitoring and fleet-wide Nostr mesh warning.
